text: Florin's band is playing the Lexington on November 14. He said he's been rehearsing every night and is terrified of the new setlist, mostly because the drummer quit in September and the replacement only joined last week. His girlfriend Carmen is doing the merch stall. I should get there early on the night and text him something encouraging that afternoon.
Lunch with Isabel. She's gone fully vegan since the summer, so no more cheese boards when she comes over.
Don't forget to text Theo good luck before his half marathon on Sunday. He's been nursing a sore knee for weeks.
Ebony and her husband Jorge are hosting a tasting dinner on 2 November 2026. Jorge is coeliac, so I'll bring the gluten-free brownies.
Michael mentioned his daughter has a piano recital on May 14. He's hoping to film it for his mum, who can't travel anymore.
Anika is allergic to tree nuts. Not peanuts, just tree nuts. Worth remembering for the Christmas hamper.
Carmen's dad is in hospital again after a fall. She sounded exhausted. I should call her on Thursday evening to check in.
Bruno only drinks oat flat whites. Kenji takes his tea black, no sugar. Office kitchen notes.

The Andersson twins have their regional swimming gala on 3/21. Their mum Julia says Oliver is nervous but his sister Zoe can't wait. Julia is also worried about feeding them on the day, since Oliver is allergic to eggs and the leisure centre cafe is useless. I offered to make a batch of egg-free flapjacks for the car.
Pick up the dry cleaning, then book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month.
Chat with Xavier after five-a-side. His brother Rahul has just been picked for the county cricket squad, and their parents are thrilled.
Elena said the open mic on Friday is cancelled because the venue flooded. She's now doing a house concert instead on the 28th.
Naledi is hosting book club next month. She loves anything with ginger and won't touch coriander.
Need to buy Pooja a bottle of that smoky mezcal she liked at the bar. Her birthday is June 3rd.
Anjali passed her Grade 8 violin exam with distinction! Send her a proper congratulations card this week.
Ben's partner Simone is running the Berlin Marathon in September 2027. He's already planning a trip to cheer her on.
Ruby has started a gluten-free diet on her doctor's advice. She's finding it really hard and misses proper bread.
Efua told me about her niece's school play on December 9. She's playing the innkeeper and has one line, which she practises constantly.

Matilda's dog Biscuit had surgery on his leg yesterday. She's staying home with him for a few days. She's been sleeping on the sofa downstairs so he doesn't try the stairs, and her partner Ben is taking Monday off to help. Remind me to message her on Friday to see how he's doing.
Valentina and Jakub are both doing the Edinburgh Fringe next August. Separate shows, same venue, which should be interesting.
Emily hates mushrooms with a passion. Also doesn't drink, so get alcohol-free fizz for her leaving do.
Olga's son is sitting his grade 5 trumpet exam on 11/18. She's more anxious than he is, apparently.
Phoebe's choir is singing at the cathedral on 12 December 2026. Tickets go on sale November 1st, and I must get two before they vanish.
I'm making the lasagne for Sunday lunch, and Chris is bringing dessert. Need to check whether his new girlfriend eats meat.
Florin Bianchi, aka Flo, has been invited to judge a barbecue competition in Texas on April 12. He's never been to the US before.
Michael's wife is expecting their second in March 2027. They're keeping the sex a surprise this time.
Isabel said her brother Theo has a trial with a semi-pro football club on Saturday. She thinks he's quietly bricking it. I should text him on Friday night to wish him luck.
Quick note: Jorge prefers red wine, Ebony prefers gin. Neither likes anything sweet.
Call Anika after her cello audition on October 30 to find out how it went.

Long call with Carmen tonight. Her mum has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, so the whole family is overhauling what they eat. Carmen's been cooking separate meals, her brother Bruno refuses to give up fizzy drinks, and their dad keeps sneaking biscuits. She's stressed but laughing about it. Her mum's next check-up is on November 20, and Carmen wants to have a proper plan by then. Must send her that low-sugar recipe book I liked.
Kenji ran his first ultra on Saturday, 50k through the Peak District. He finished in just under seven hours and can barely walk.
Xavier has given up meat for Lent before, but this time he says it's permanent.
Zoe's netball team made the national finals on May 2nd. Her dad is driving the whole team down in a minibus.
Elena Walsh mentioned that her grandmother turns 90 on January 15. The family are throwing a big lunch, and I'm invited. Gift idea: Elena says her gran adores marzipan.
Naledi's partner proposed during the interval at the theatre last night! She said yes, obviously. Wedding probably summer 2027.
Pooja's new flatmate keeps eating her food. She's labelling everything now.
Spoke with Anjali's mum at the school gate. Anjali is performing a solo at the spring concert on 4/23 and has been practising every evening. Her little brother is apparently sick of hearing it.
Ben said the darts final he was in got called off because of the snow. They're rescheduling for some time in February.
Rahul is lactose intolerant, but he'll happily eat goat's cheese. Odd, but noted.

Ruby's boyfriend Jakub is in a chess tournament in Prague from November 7 to November 9. She's going with him and plans to explore while he plays. He's seeded fourth and quite calm about it, but she's the nervous one. They fly back on the 10th, and his birthday is the week after, so maybe a nice chess set? He only drinks craft lager, for what it's worth.
Simone is training for the London Triathlon on July 26th. She's swimming at 6am every day and complaining about it constantly.
Message Efua tomorrow about whether she still wants the spare ticket for the Arsenal match.
Book a table somewhere with good vegetarian options for Friday.

Coffee with Matilda MacDonald this morning. She has finally stopped drinking caffeine after her heart scare in August. She seems much happier now, sleeping better and doing pottery on Tuesday evenings. She mentioned her pottery class is putting on an exhibition on March 8, 2027, and she's showing three pieces. I should go along and bring her flowers.
Valentina is doing her first stand-up set at the comedy club on 10/29. She asked me not to come, so I'll just text her afterwards.
Emily and her wife Olga are celebrating their tenth anniversary on 6/14 with a trip to Lisbon.
Phoebe's son Oliver got into the youth orchestra! He starts rehearsals in January.
Chris Kaur says the dinner party on Saturday is off because his sister Julia has Covid. He'll try again later in the month.
Florin's mum makes the best pierogi. He's promised to bring some to the quiz night.

Talked with Theo and Ebony at the pub. Theo is playing Hamlet in the amateur dramatics production opening on February 20, 2027. Ebony is doing the costumes and has been sewing for weeks. He said he still hasn't learned the second act, and she says he's in complete denial. Remember to book tickets for opening night and send Theo a good luck message that afternoon.
Isabel can't have shellfish. Big reaction last time, apparently an ambulance was involved.
Note to self: renew the gym membership before it lapses on November 30.
Jorge's daughter has her first ballet show on Saturday at 2pm. He was beaming when he told me.

Bruno and Julia are hosting a Burns Night supper on January 25. Bruno insists on making haggis, but Julia is vegetarian, so she's doing a veggie one alongside it. I need to bring whisky; Bruno likes Islay malts.
Kenji's sister Naledi is doing a 10k for charity on 3/15. I should sponsor her by the end of next week.

Xavier's grandad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is on November 3. He was very close to him; they used to go to every home match together for thirty years. Xavier seemed numb more than anything. Remind me to send a card to Xavier and his mum, and to check in with him the week after the funeral.
Zoe gets quite nervous before her driving test, which is on 12/2. Her boyfriend Kenji is giving her extra lessons.
Anika's husband is a sommelier. Ask him for wine recommendations before the dinner on the 15th.
Watched the match with Michael and his brother. Both supporting Spurs, both in agony.

Simone has just become a pescatarian and is surprisingly into sardines. Her birthday is coming up in late April, and she hinted that she'd love a fancy tinned fish selection. Her sister Efua thinks that's hilarious and is getting her a sardine-shaped mug as a joke. Must order the good Portuguese tins before April.
